quality_guards: Fire controls depend on premises use, occupancy, vulnerable people, processes, layout, ignition sources and available evacuation routes.
Workplace-fire evidence is premises- and activity-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fire probability.
Flood actions depend on warning type, source, location, forecast, property vulnerability, access routes and available support.
Flood-warning evidence is location- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level flood probability.
Drinking-water action depends on the notice, contaminant, affected supply, duration, consumer vulnerability and current water-company instructions.
Drinking-water evidence is supply-, incident- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level contamination probability.
Breakdown actions depend on road layout, traffic, vehicle condition, occupants, visibility, signals and whether a safe refuge can be reached.
Motorway-safety evidence is journey-, incident- and condition-specific and is not an exact parcel-level collision probability.
The correct road-user action depends on the road layout, crossing type, visibility, speed, traffic, user vulnerability and current signals.
Highway-Code evidence is manoeuvre- and context-specific and is not an exact parcel-level road-collision probability.
Required recall action depends on the exact product, model, batch, hazard, corrective action, owner status and current alert.
Product-safety evidence is product- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Maritime controls depend on vessel type, voyage, weather, sea state, occupants, equipment, competence and distance from rescue.
Maritime-safety evidence is vessel-, voyage- and condition-specific and is not an exact parcel-level drowning probability.
Building-safety duties depend on building height and use, common parts, accountable-person roles, risk assessment and resident circumstances.
High-rise safety evidence is building- and dutyholder-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fire or structural-failure probability.
Weather-health action depends on current alert level, region, forecast impacts, vulnerable groups, services and local response capability.
Weather-health evidence is region- and time-specific and is not a permanent parcel-level health probability.
Emergency-alert response depends on the alert's authenticity, affected area, hazard, instructions, device accessibility and personal safety.
Emergency-alert evidence is event-, location- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level emergency probability.
